note: The TrackMan-style fixed placement box. The unit stands placement_window_m behind the ball, measured from the lens along its boresight, on the target line; the box covers ball positions on the ground across that window and half_width_m either side, drawn with a margin for the camera tilt's uncertainty (rows only). A ball outside the window is labelled, never blocked (D15). The box never yields a distance: the IWR gives it.
